headline: **MLB Daily Recap: August 4, 2026**
article:
The St. Louis Cardinals secured a convincing 13-7 victory over the New York Yankees, with Alec Burleson leading the charge at the plate. Burleson hit three home runs and drove in six runs, including a key 18th homer that scored JJ Wetherholt. The Washington Nationals suffered a 6-3 loss to the Philadelphia Phillies, while the Pittsburgh Pirates edged out the Milwaukee Brewers in a close matchup, securing a 4-3 victory.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, including Oakland Athletics left-handed pitcher Jeffrey Springs, who has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to right hip discomfort. The Athletics have also placed first baseman Nick Kurtz on the 10-day injured list retroactive to August 1, 2026, with a strained right thumb. The Chicago Cubs have placed right-handed pitcher Clay Holmes on the 60-day injured list, while the Los Angeles Dodgers have placed catcher Dalton Rushing on the 10-day injured list with right elbow inflammation.

The Oakland Athletics have bolstered their pitching staff with the addition of right-handed pitcher Seth Johnson, acquired in a trade with the Philadelphia Phillies. Johnson joins the Athletics in exchange for outfielder Colby Thomas. The Miami Marlins have traded right-handed pitcher Lake Bachar to the Pittsburgh Pirates for right-handed pitcher Brandan Bidois, left fielder Brian Sanchez, and infielder Hyun Seung Lee.
